_comment: What sites are called on their title cards, made from each site's seed so every machine calls it the same. The planet: a catalogue, a number between the two given, and which planet of that star ('KEPLER-91 IV'). The site: a qualifier, a kind, a two-figure number and the region it is in ('POLAR RESEARCH FACILITY 06, NORTH CRYOSPHERE'). Only the examples agreed so far are listed: add to the lists.
